description: Java source file implementing the Android Monkey testing tool, which injects random events and performs system testing by simulating user interactions and system actions.

classes.name: Monkey
classes.description: Main class implementing the Android Monkey testing tool, responsible for parsing options, setting up system interfaces, and running the event injection loop.

classes.name: ActivityController
classes.description: Inner class implementing the activity controller callback for monitoring app activity states, crashes, and responses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Monkey tool which initializes and runs the monkey.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executing the monkey test cycles based on command-line parameters.

methods.name: processOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line options for configuring the monkey run.

methods.name: loadPackageLists
methods.description: Loads package allowlist or denylist files.

methods.name: getSystemInterfaces
methods.description: Establishes connections to system services like ActivityManager, WindowManager, and PackageManager.

methods.name: getMainApps
methods.description: Builds a list of main activities suitable for launch based on categories.

methods.name: runMonkeyCycles
methods.description: Runs the main event injection loop for the specified number of cycles, injecting random system events.

methods.name: checkNativeCrashes
methods.description: Monitors for new native crashes by detecting tombstone files.

methods.name: reportProcRank
methods.description: Runs procrank to measure process status.

methods.name: reportAnrTraces
methods.description: Dumps recent ANR traces for debugging.

methods.name: reportDumpsysMemInfo
methods.description: Runs dumpsys meminfo to collect memory information.

methods.name: commandLineReport
methods.description: Executes a command line tool and outputs reports.

methods.name: writeScriptLog
methods.description: Logs each iteration of script execution.

methods.name: getBugreport
methods.description: Collects and saves a bugreport with a specified filename.

methods.name: signalPersistentProcesses
methods.description: Sends a signal to persistent processes for profiling.

methods.name: waitForTombstoneToBeWritten
methods.description: Waits for tombstone files to be fully written before reading.
